scope: Uninstrumented portable X11 password-only generation, import, encrypted backup, restart and fresh-profile restore; disposable generated and public fixture roots only

steps.name: Explicit first-run password-only generation and Main account overview without phrase reveal
Password-only generated root restored from verified encrypted backup into an empty profile
Native input-only BIP39 import with production KDF
Go-owned verified receive QR and exact independent public address
Native encrypted portable backup creation and reopen verification
Restart requires native unlock and preserves deterministic address
Portable restore into empty profile without original application state
Captured logs and persisted profile files contain no tested secret canaries
